summary: Enhance your skills with our GBV and Law Enforcement Training Course. Learn effective strategies to address gender-based violence in your community.
lede: Gender-based violence response training prepares law enforcement and justice professionals to handle cases while protecting survivors’ rights. It covers identifying forms of GBV and risk, conducting sensitive interviews, documenting evidence, building case files, and coordinating referrals through survivor-centered, trauma-informed practice, with attention to confidentiality and due process.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who directly or indirectly handle GBV cases, survivors, or related decisions.
audience: Social welfare or child protection officers
Gender or human rights desks within police
GBV focal persons or gender units
modules: Foundations of GBV and Law Enforcement
Legal and Policy Frameworks for GBV Cases
Survivor Centered and Trauma Informed Response
Interviewing Survivors, Witnesses, and Alleged Perpetrators
Evidence Collection, Documentation, and Case Building
Ethics, Professional Conduct, and Officer Wellbeing
Community Engagement, Prevention, and Trust Building
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of criminal law and experience in law enforcement or justice roles. Prior exposure to GBV cases is beneficial but not mandatory.
